source.title: LOGOS: A Living Logic for AI Agent Teams That Evolve With Humans

EXPLORE_PROPOSAL.evidence: Proposal examples are used to construct candidates.

TUNE_SELECTION.evidence: A separate selection split chooses among multiple generated candidates.

CERTIFY_FINAL_GATE.evidence: The final gate split is disjoint from proposal examples and from the candidate-selection split; candidate and selection rule must be fixed before the final gate stream begins.
requirements: final-gate examples and per-example failures hidden from proposer
bets predictable from past gate information only
fresh i.i.d. gate stream, replacement sampling from fixed gate pool, or fixed-sample evaluation without sequential claim

OUTER_REPORT.evidence: Reported before/after numbers use a third report holdout that the paper states is not used for proposal, selection, or adoption.

long_horizon_statistical_control.candidate_local: portfolio e-process over gain and regression streams; e-value converted to p-value using Ville inequality under stated assumptions
long_horizon_statistical_control.composite_decision: intersection-union composite p-value is the maximum of gain, regression, and optional safety p-values
long_horizon_statistical_control.cross_candidate: LORD-style online ledger spends alpha-wealth across candidate decisions
long_horizon_statistical_control.scope_warning: Formal online control requires conditionally super-uniform candidate p-values, predictable spending, valid dependence assumptions, fresh valid evaluation data, and no invalid adaptive holdout reuse; otherwise the paper calls the ledger conservative audit accounting rather than an FDR guarantee.

feedback_firewall.acknowledged_leakage: Repeated aggregate feedback can still leak information.
feedback_firewall.mitigation: Root policy defines a gate-exposure budget over max decisions, max aggregate releases, and cumulative privacy loss, and retires or refreshes final-gate examples after exposure, selection pressure, budget exhaustion, or drift.

common_candidate_replay_2500.note: Constructed deterministic common-candidate mechanism check, not a population estimate of natural proposal quality.

non_saturated_multiseed.note: Anytime-valid gate reported zero report-holdout regressions in the displayed HotpotQA/MATH-500 cells because it fully rejected in low-signal conditions; this is conservative error-accounted behavior, not evidence of high adoption power.

gpt4o_mini_report_holdout.note: Complementary per-decision view; selected K=1 candidates were beneficial or neutral on report holdout; paired K=3 MATH-500 rejected an unproven candidate.

implementation_and_provenance.github_search_result: No author/Fujitsu public repository implementing the LOGOS protocol was identified in this run. CatalyzeX currently presents Request Code. Fujitsu's public MAAF technology page describes the self-evolution technology and links the LOGOS paper, but does not expose source code.
implementation_and_provenance.consequence: Treat the four-surface composition as primary-paper protocol evidence, not executable source-bound verification. Do not claim provider crash safety, durable LORD state, report-holdout zero-query conformance, or exact paper-run replay from public code.

design_update.previous_missing_composition: EXPLORE/TRAIN -> adaptive TUNE/VAL -> frozen CERTIFY with candidate-local anytime-valid evidence -> untouched OUTER/TEST
design_update.status_after_this_source: LOGOS specifies this composition at paper-contract level and additionally specifies cross-candidate LORD accounting and a bounded gate-feedback channel.
design_update.remaining_gap: Public executable code/run chronology is unbound, and the stronger requirement that OUTER be unused by rollback, routing, stopping and recovery has not been executable-verified.

exact_next_action: Search for a public executable implementation of the LOGOS/MAAF four-surface protocol or another open-source self-improvement system with the same composition. Require source-bound evidence that (1) candidate/selection state is frozen before CERTIFY, (2) certification evidence is candidate-local anytime-valid under its actual sampling regime, (3) cross-candidate statistical state is durable across restart, (4) report/outer queries are zero before terminal reporting and unused by promotion, rollback, routing, stopping and recovery, and (5) proposal chronology and immutable artifact identities are retained. Revisit Harn only if its provider-operation/hypothesis paths change materially.
